lead: `bun nv proofs --run` started while `bun nv verify --start` is still running fails in its own build and prints cargo's whole JSON stream.
body: Both build `target/covws/`, the running verify holds `nvs.exe` there, and `tools/nv/lib/covws.ts` puts cargo's standard output into the error it throws. Run the proofs before `--start` or after `--wait`, never between them.
